easy.title: Yank Me
easy.description: Player stacks cups with index cards in between and pulls out the cards to form one stack of cups

easy.title: A Bit Dicey
easy.description: Player holds the popsicle stick in their mouth and stacks the 6 dice on it, the dice must be held for three seconds.

easy.title: Breakfast Scramble
easy.description: Player puts the cereal box puzzle together

easy.title: Stick the Landing
materials: 1 half full water bottle for flipping
easy.description: Player must flip water bottle on to table - video says to do it once but we can add more successful landings

easy.title: Puddle Jumper
easy.description: Player must flip water bottle on to table - video says to do it once but we can add more successful landings

easy.title: Flip Your Lid
easy.description: 2 Players have to flip the cup onto the bottle from 1 foot away

medium.title: Spin Doctor
medium.description: Player spins the coin across the middle of the table to the other player who must stop the coin with their finger

medium.title: Do You Hear What I Hear
materials: 7 boxes with small bells, from 5 bells to 35 bells
medium.description: 2 Players must order the boxes from least amount of bells to largest amount of bells

medium.title: Speed Eraser
materials: 7 glass cups (1 can also be used)
medium.description: Player must bounce pencils off their eraser end into the glass cups - 7 times

medium.title: Tilt-a-cup
medium.description: Player bounces a ping pong ball into the stack, pulls bottom cup to top of stack, repeats until 6 balls have landed

medium.title: Shoe Fly Shoe
medium.description: Player flings a shoe off of their foot to a table 9 feet away and lands the shoe on the table

medium.title: Sharp Shooter
medium.description: Player shoots rubber bands at 3 cards held by clothespins 8 feet away

medium.title: Office Tennis
materials: 2 clipboards (or any hard surfaces for bouncing)
medium.description: Players must rally the paper ball across the room into a garbage can, players cannot double hit

medium.title: Pong^5
medium.description: Player must bounce 5 balls in the cup all in a row - if they miss one they have to restart

hard.title: Chop Stack
hard.description: Player must use the chopsticks to stack 4 chapsticks on the table

hard.title: Double Trouble
hard.description: Player must bounce two ping pong balls at once with one hand and land both balls in the same toss, one in each cup

hard.title: Go The Distance
materials: 3 cups (smaller cups for a harder challenge)
hard.description: Player must guide the ping pong balls across the tape measure into the cups at 5, 6, and 7 feet away

hard.title: High Roller
hard.description: Player must pick up dice in the cup with one hand and spin the dice into a stack of 3, 4, and 5

hard.title: Back Flip
hard.description: Player must balance sets of pencils on their hand and catch the stack, starting at 2 and going to 12

hard.title: Bridge the Gap
materials: two thick books or platforms of the same size
hard.description: Player must make a bridge of cards across an 11 inch gap and place the box in the middle
